cases.reason: Actual model identities distinguish closed-model disposal from the independent live sibling that keeps the panel mounted. Positive sibling control rules out disposing all models.

cases.reason: Hides the real legacy surface before actual file close, then opens another model and remounts; checks old model disposal and total current models. Exercises hidden cleanup without equating a normal unmount with closure.

cases.title: preserves a still-open model across a normal panel unmount and remount
cases.reason: Checks the same actual open model survives hiding and remains the registry instance after remount. It controls the false repair of unconditional model disposal.
